tools.name: orbit_agent_invoke
tools.description: Submit one asynchronous agent invocation for exploration or debugging and return its run ID, or wait for its answer with `wait_seconds`. An operator's invocation is deprecated: it runs outside Orbit's filesystem sandbox as the same OS user as Orbit, so it can reach anything that user can, and needs operator capability. An implement or review-repair agent may instead delegate a read-only question to a sandboxed explorer that reads its own worktree and writes nothing when `workflow.explore.enabled` is on; with no eligible explorer crew the call is refused before any run exists, so continue without delegating. Every other caller is refused, a refusal never stops the caller's run, and an invocation changes no task, opens no pull request and dispatches nothing. Queueing, budgets, answer and progress fields, and run observation: installed Orbit skill `references/tool-surface.md`, section `Host agent invocation`.

timeout_seconds.description: Provider wall-clock bound in seconds, excluding queue time. Defaults to 1800; must be from 1 to 7200, the activity's enforced ceiling. An explorer defaults to, and may not exceed, `workflow.explore.timeout_seconds`.

Operator invocations only: an explorer is always read-only.

context_files.description: Replaces the whole selector list; omit both context fields to preserve it. To extend, read `context_files` and send the deduplicated union of all existing and new selectors. Policy and clear/create cases: installed Orbit skill `references/task-fields.md`.

field.description: Compatibility alias for a single response field projection, such as `field: "history"`.

request_id.description: Optional retry-safe guarded write identity. Requires explicit workspace and expected_revision. Reuse identical input to reconcile a lost reply; returns a fresh versioned snapshot.

expected_revision.description: Observed revision from task.show snapshot:true. Guarded mode accepts field edits, a comment, or a verdict separately.

complete.description: Guarded review only: explicitly complete an accepted review with existing trusted operator authority. Default false; never merges, publishes or dispatches.

tools.name: orbit_visual_capture
tools.description: Render the current working tree (uncommitted changes included) for each of a task's `mocks/` artifacts and write, per mock, `mock.png`, `capture.png` and `side-by-side.png` plus one `rules.json` with the workspace's UI rule results for those captures, under the output directory. Each mock name gives the view, state, theme and width, resolved against the view manifests configured in `visual_review.manifests`, whose fixture serves the app. This is the implementer's self-check: it attaches nothing and records nothing on the task, and its output is not evidence of record. Needs a verified browser kit on the host and a configured manifest; without either it fails naming what is missing. A mock whose view never renders is reported per mock as `render_timeout`, and one whose app's setup fails as `setup_failed`.

id.description: Task ID whose `mocks/` artifacts name the views to capture.

mock.description: Capture only this one mock artifact (its full `mocks/…` path) instead of every mock of the task.

out.description: Directory the captures are written under, one subdirectory per mock. Defaults to `.orbit/tmp/visual/<task-id>` in the checkout.

tools.name: orbit_workflow_auto
tools.description: Observe workspace auto-drain readiness, start a bounded window, stop admissions while preserving admitted workers (or, with force, stop those workers too), or resize a running drain's worker limit. Resize keeps the run ID, deadline, completion authorization and dispatched children; a lower limit only stops new admissions and cancels nothing. Requires trusted operator authority and an explicit workspace. Start is not retry-safe: reconcile readiness and runs after a lost reply before another submission.

for_seconds.description: Required for start: window length in seconds, 1 through 86400 (24 hours)

auto_concurrency.description: Start only: off, shadow or enforce for this local drain. Omitted captures machine.auto_concurrency.mode. Retained on resume/restart; changes no configuration. Unsupported for pull drains

concurrency.description: Worker limit, positive u32. Optional for start (omitted uses runtime default); required for resize. Status previews this ceiling; omitted uses the live local drain, then live pull drain, then default. The drain's only ceiling: delivery jobs impose none of their own

task.description: Status only: one task ID or a list to explain instead of the bounded backlog

limit.description: Status only: maximum tasks to explain, including an explicit selection (1-500; default 50)

allow_crew.description: Status only: configured crews to evaluate; omitted uses the live drain's restriction, if any

id.description: Resize only: auto- or pull-drain run ID. Omitted targets the workspace's one live drain; refused when none or several are live

if_revision.description: Resize only: apply only if the run's worker limit is still at this revision, so a concurrent change is reported rather than overwritten

reason.description: Resize only: note recorded with the change

complete.description: Start only: explicitly authorize automatic completion for all tasks admitted by this window; default false keeps review. Does not approve proposed tasks

review.description: Start only: add this review layer before landing (before-landing recommended; before-pr deprecated but honoured) to the window when workspace policy applies none; every task it admits inherits it. The layer policy already applies is accepted unchanged; the other layer, a workspace that sets neither workflow.purpose_crews.pre_landing_review nor workflow.purpose_crews.review and a workspace that delivers locally are refused. It can only add review. Omitted keeps workspace policy

approve_proposed.description: Start only: each pass pilots qualifying proposed tasks (tagged no-diff-expected, or with context_files and an assessed complexity) and approves into backlog those with no duplicate, already-landed, conflict or warning finding, including tasks filed during the window. Tasks tagged no-auto-approve are never approved. Others stay proposed; status reports approved and held counts. Default false

force.description: Stop only: also cancel each live drain and stop its in-flight work. A pull drain's claimed leaves are stopped and their tasks return to the owner's backlog with a comment; a local drain's task runs are cancelled. A leaf that cannot be confirmed stopped keeps its claim and fails the call. Default false stops admissions only

tools.name: orbit_workflow_land
tools.description: Land a task in review: merge its one open delivery pull request at the head whose required checks were just read, then move the task to done. The forge's branch protection decides: nothing bypasses it, and any refusal answers `task_landing_refused` with the reason and changes nothing. A pull request that already merged settles without another merge, so a call whose reply was lost may be repeated. Requires operator capability or a resident cycle holding the `merge` right.

tools.description: Resume a terminal resumable workflow run as a new linked run, or explicitly authorize review-only same-PR source repair of an eligible owner-local publication, including successful or stopped inline publication with unmet acceptance. Requires operator capability; agent sessions are refused.

id.description: Job run ID.

claim_token.description: Token for this workspace's exclusive claim, required when another operator holds one. Falls back to `ORBIT_WORKSPACE_CLAIM_TOKEN`.

source_repair.description: Explicit operator recovery of an eligible stopped owner-local publication. Inspect: {action: inspect, task_id} returns binding, review, policy_digest, immutable reservations and reservation_digests. Submit: {action: submit, task_id, request_key, binding, diagnosis}; successful or kept inline publication rework also requires unmet_acceptance evidence and the inspected current policy_digest. Select the original publishing run explicitly, including after empty failed successors; inspection authenticates its stopped lineage, unchanged specification and exact PR head. Supply the exact binding object and author a valid execution plan before submission; lifecycle refusal creates no reservation. To recover an existing reservation with no admitted run after correcting only an empty or placeholder plan, use {action: reconcile, task_id, request_key, reservation_digest, binding, diagnosis} with the original key, its inspected reservation_digest, fresh binding and otherwise unchanged evidence/policy. This appends fresh operator authorization while preserving the original reservation and charge; identical replay returns the one admitted run. Other meaning, identity, actor, policy or lease changes refuse reconciliation. Diagnosis and unmet_acceptance accept 1-32768 bytes each. Captures current review and workflow.required_validation_commands: configured commands require fresh candidate evidence; an empty list records skipped_no_required_commands, not a passing check, and does not waive configured review or hosted required checks. Reuses the original PR and preserves historical completion deadlines; grants no completion, merge or auto-fix authority.
